Definition: from G1418 and κόλον (food); properly, fastidious about eating (peevish), i.e. (genitive case) impracticable:--hard.
BiblicalUsage: Hard, as the disciples were astonished at Jesus' words about how hard it is for those who trust in riches to enter the kingdom of God.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that trusting in riches is the hardness Jesus names, not the riches themselves, and the cure is to trust in God instead.
